obligations.summary: Providers of high-risk AI systems that consider or have reason to consider their system is not in conformity with the Regulation must immediately take necessary corrective actions (bring into conformity, withdraw, disable, or recall) and inform distributors, deployers, authorised representatives, and importers accordingly.

Where a high-risk AI system presents a risk within the meaning of Article 79(1) and the provider becomes aware of that risk, the provider must immediately investigate the causes in collaboration with the reporting deployer (where applicable) and inform the competent market surveillance authorities and, where applicable, the notified body that issued a certificate under Article 44, specifying the nature of the non-compliance and any corrective actions taken.
